import system

	db = value['db']
	query = "SELECT DataAnswer FROM registerhistory WHERE NodeID = ? AND PapoID = ? AND RegisterTypeID = ?"
	params = [6, 1, 7]
	ds = system.db.runPrepQuery(query, params, db)
	
	if ds.rowCount > 0:
	    data_str = ds.getValueAt(0,0)   # String JSON desde la DB
	    data = system.util.jsonDecode(data_str)  # Ahora es dict/list usable en Ignition
	    return data
	else:
	    return {}

transforms.code:
# Traer la lista de selectionRun (ya es una lista de dicts)
	selectionRun = value
	tableInterval = self.view.params.dsTableScaleInterval #this.props.params.dsTableScalesInterval
	
	# Obtener todos los WorkorderID de esa lista
	workorderIDs = [item["WorkorderID"] for item in selectionRun]
	#return workorderIDs
	# Convertir el dataset entrante a PyDataset
	pyds = system.dataset.toPyDataSet(tableInterval)
	#return pyds
	# Crear lista para las filas filtradas
	filteredRows = []
	
	for row in pyds:
	    if row["WorkorderID"] in workorderIDs:
	        filteredRows.append([
	            row["WorkOrderID"],
	            row["Performance"] if row["Performance"] is None else row["Performance"] *100
	        ])
	
	# Encabezados originales
	headers = ["WorkOrderID", "Performance"]
	
	# Retornar dataset filtrado
	return system.dataset.toDataSet(headers, filteredRows)
